rationale:
The signed lending problem requires document-completeness and scan-quality practice using realistic linked PDF artifacts.
Assumptions: All people, employers, accounts, identifiers and values are synthetic
Evaluation: PDF readability; field extraction; missing-page detection; cross-document income reconciliation; review routing
Constraints: Read-only; no automated eligibility decision; preserve source provenance

learnerArtifacts.name: Linked application document index
learnerArtifacts.purpose: Maps every synthetic income document to its loan application, product and declared document type.

learnerArtifacts.name: LoanTrak keyed values
learnerArtifacts.purpose: Synthetic system-of-record values to reconcile against the application documents.

learnerArtifacts.name: Learner-safe loan intake events
learnerArtifacts.purpose: Pre-decision events for APP evaluation cases plus a distinct HIST synthetic baseline. APP underwriting outcomes remain assessor-only.

learnerArtifacts.name: Evaluation contract and coverage
learnerArtifacts.purpose: Learner-safe condition counts, row semantics, metric formulas and expected prototype output schema; application-level answers remain private.

learnerArtifacts.name: Template sources and limitations
learnerArtifacts.purpose: Immutable source/raster hashes, domain and reuse limitations for every document format.

learnerArtifacts.name: Linked income-document packets
learnerArtifacts.purpose: Template-based synthetic income documents grouped into application packets with visible scan-quality variation.

assessorArtifacts.name: Private planted-condition truth
assessorArtifacts.purpose: Hidden expected extractions, defects, and outcomes for independent evaluation.
